status: provisional masked animation prototype; not runtime-integrated
bearing: true front-left quarter; nose image-left; do not mirror

animationMap.frames0to2: exact rest pose; exact duplicate base cells
animationMap.frame3: beginning arm lift; phase3 atlas pose
animationMap.frames5to10: exact repeated offer hold; one identical pose for every cell
animationMap.frame11: partial retraction between full offer and rest; phase11 atlas pose

anatomy: Only anatomical LEFT offer arm/sleeve/hand animates on image-right for this bearing. Anatomical RIGHT hand at RIGHT pouch remains static on image-left. Never mirror.

compositing.method: Copy approved base cell unchanged, then overlay only candidate turquoise sleeve/skin pixels plus adjacent dark outline pixels from the generated keypose, clipped to the following top-down logical cell polygon.

limitations: The arm pose source atlas was image-generated; compositing kept every pixel outside the arm mask identical to the approved base.
Review limb attachment and partial-return pose in the preview before any runtime use.

tool: built-in image_gen for keypose atlas; deterministic nearest-neighbor normalization and alpha/color-masked pixel compositing for fixed-body sheet
